paper.title_en: A rigid spherical shell enclosing a degenerate wormhole
paper.abstract_en: A static configuration consisting of a rigid spherical shell enclosing a degenerate Schwarzschild Klinkhamer wormhole is investigated in general relativity. The shell is analyzed using the Israel junction conditions, while the total ADM mass is assumed to remain fixed. For an ordinary rigid shell in Schwarzschild spacetime, the proper mass is given by the Brown York relation. It is shown that replacing the flat interior by a degenerate vacuum wormhole changes the junction conditions in such a way that the proper mass of the shell vanishes, whereas the ADM mass and the exterior Schwarzschild geometry remain unchanged. The resulting configuration is therefore entirely characterized by the wormhole geometry as the carrier of the gravitational field. The physical interpretation of this result is discussed, together with its relation to the previously established collapse dynamics of degenerate wormholes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究广义相对论中一个刚性球壳包裹简并虫洞的静态构型，与一般相对论基础相关。
decision.title_zh: 一个包裹简并虫洞的刚性球壳
decision.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中研究了一个由刚性球壳包裹简并Schwarzschild Klinkhamer虫洞的静态构型。使用Israel衔接条件分析壳层，同时假设总ADM质量保持不变。对于Schwarzschild时空中的普通刚性壳，其固有质量由Brown York关系给出。研究表明，将平坦内部替换为简并真空虫洞会改变衔接条件，使得壳的固有质量消失，而ADM质量和外部的Schwarzschild几何保持不变。因此，所得构型完全由作为引力场载体的虫洞几何来表征。本文讨论了这一结果的物理解释，及其与先前建立的简并虫洞坍缩动力学的关联。
